title: श्रीराम का जन्म कैसे हुआ | रामायण भाग 3
topic: Dasharatha's longing and the birth of four princes (Valmiki Ramayana 1.8–1.18)

scenes.narration: राम नवमी तो सब मनाते हैं... पर क्या आप जानते हैं, श्रीराम के जन्म की शुरुआत एक कटोरी खीर से हुई थी?
scenes.visual: a golden vessel of sweet rice pudding glowing on a stone altar, four lotus flowers around it, soft divine light, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: कहानी शुरू होती है अयोध्या से — धन-धान्य से भरी, सुखी प्रजा, और धर्म के पक्के राजा दशरथ। उनके पास सब कुछ था।
scenes.visual: the ancient city of Ayodhya at sunrise with grand palaces and temple spires by the Sarayu river, and King Dasharatha, a dignified middle-aged Indian king with a short grey beard and moustache, ornate golden crown, gold jewellery, rich saffron and white royal garments standing on a palace balcony, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: सब कुछ... बस एक पुत्र नहीं, जो उनका वंश आगे बढ़ाए। राजा हर रात प्रार्थना करते थे।
scenes.visual: King Dasharatha, a dignified middle-aged Indian king with a short grey beard and moustache, ornate golden crown, gold jewellery, rich saffron and white royal garments, seated alone on a golden throne in a vast moonlit palace hall, gazing at an empty cradle, sorrowful, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: तब उन्होंने सबसे बड़ा राजयज्ञ करने का निश्चय किया — अश्वमेध यज्ञ।
scenes.visual: a majestic white horse with royal ornaments standing before a sacrificial altar with priests, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: यज्ञ की अग्नि जलाने के लिए युवा ऋषि ऋष्यशृंग को बुलाया गया।
scenes.visual: the young sage Rishyashringa, slender with matted hair in a topknot, bare chest with a white sacred thread, ochre dhoti, holding a ladle over a sacred fire, chanting before a great blazing sacrificial fire in a yajna pavilion, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: उधर देवता रावण से भयभीत थे। ब्रह्मा जी के वरदान से वो देवताओं और दानवों से अजेय था... पर मनुष्यों से उसने कभी डर ही नहीं माना।
scenes.visual: landscape only, no people: a menacing dark silhouette of a ten-headed demon king against a stormy red sky over an island fortress, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: तब भगवान विष्णु ने मनुष्य रूप में जन्म लेने का वचन दिया — राजा दशरथ के पुत्र बनकर।
scenes.visual: a radiant celestial light shaped like a lotus with a conch and discus glowing within it, rays of gold and pale blue chalk spreading across a starry sky, no human figure, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: यज्ञ की अग्नि से एक तेजस्वी पुरुष प्रकट हुआ, हाथ में देवताओं की बनाई खीर का स्वर्ण पात्र लिए।
scenes.visual: a radiant divine being rising from a sacred fire holding a golden vessel of sweet rice pudding, King Dasharatha, a dignified middle-aged Indian king with a short grey beard and moustache, ornate golden crown, gold jewellery, rich saffron and white royal garments kneeling before it with folded hands, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: राजा ने आधी खीर कौशल्या को दी, बची हुई का आधा सुमित्रा को, उसका आधा कैकेयी को, और आख़िरी हिस्सा फिर से सुमित्रा को।
फिर चैत्र मास की नवमी तिथि को, महारानी कौशल्या की गोद में श्रीराम का जन्म हुआ। इसीलिए हम मनाते हैं राम नवमी।
scenes.visual: Queen Kausalya, a graceful Indian queen in a white and gold silk sari with a gold crown and long braided hair seen from the side, tenderly holding a softly glowing newborn wrapped in white cloth, palace chamber with oil lamps, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: कैकेयी से भरत जन्मे। और सुमित्रा, जिन्हें दो हिस्से मिले थे, उन्होंने जुड़वाँ पुत्रों को जन्म दिया — लक्ष्मण और शत्रुघ्न।
scenes.visual: Queen Kaikeyi, a striking Indian queen in a deep red and gold silk sari with an ornate gold crown and Queen Sumitra, a gentle Indian queen in a green and gold silk sari with a small gold crown each seen from the side holding newborn babies wrapped in cloth, Sumitra holding twins, warm palace light, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: चार राजकुमार... और ख़ुशियों से झूम उठी अयोध्या।
scenes.visual: four young princes as small children seen from behind, playing together in a palace courtyard, King Dasharatha, a dignified middle-aged Indian king with a short grey beard and moustache, ornate golden crown, gold jewellery, rich saffron and white royal garments watching with joy, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame

scenes.narration: पर एक दिन, एक तेजस्वी ऋषि राजमहल के द्वार पर आए... और राजा से वो पुत्र माँग बैठे, जिसे देना राजा के लिए सबसे कठिन था।
scenes.visual: a tall stern elderly sage with a long white beard and a staff, seen from behind, walking toward the gates of Ayodhya at dusk, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, empty dark chalkboard space at the top and bottom, no border, no frame
